prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Stage Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split stage layout featuring a live desktop interaction preview and quick-start actions. (why: The finish step has the highest drop-off rate (31.3%) and long mean completion times (5815s), while users report post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Controls Guide Screen: Insert a new screen, new_desktop_guide, before completion to demonstrate basic desktop controls and visibility toggles. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Friend Picker Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen pick_friend into a full carousel layout with animated pet previews and badge traits. (why: Adoption has a 25.5% drop-off rate and a high median duration of 89s, indicating decision friction when picking a pet.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Voice and Sound Preview Step Flow: Introduce a dedicated voice preview step, new_sound_check, inside the adoption flow so users can sample pet sounds before adopting. (why: Adoption requires deeper engagement; providing interactive feedback builds attachment before finalizing adoption details.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Two-Column Path Choice Redesign: Redesign choose_path into a structured two-column layout contrasting preset companion path vs custom pet path. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a wide disparity between median (8s) and mean (514s) time spent.)
5: [sign_in, layout] Centered Sign-In Layout with Mascot Reassurance: Change sign_in screen to a centered layout featuring a pet mascot component and simplified account connection buttons. (why: Sign-in drops 23.1% of users, and 8 support tickets cited pets missing/reset when signing in with wrong or duplicate credentials.)
6: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Visibility Instructions Copy: Update headline and body on home_intro to explicitly explain how to unhide and invoke the pet on the desktop screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet not showing on desktop or users not knowing how to reveal the pet window.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Account Binding Safety Hint: Add a prominent hint below the sign-in form clarifying that signing in links your current pet creation directly to your primary email. (why: 8 emails reported lost or reset pets after re-authenticating, showing account linking ambiguity during sign in.)
8: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Progress Mascot: Add an animated mascot asset and progress timer component to the waiting screen while desktop engines initialize. (why: Home initialization stage takes median 201s and mean 2336s, causing 18.7% drop-off while waiting.)
9: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Certificate Stamp Incentive: Add a verified adoption badge component and celebratory headline to adoption_certificate to enhance ownership feeling. (why: Creating emotional connection on adoption certificate increases commitment through remaining sign-in and completion steps.)
